name: Workspace board
description: Every workspace as a card, in columns by what it's doing. Start new ones from the board, keep notes per workspace, and let the orchestrator read and write those notes.

tools.name: board_summary
tools.description: List this project's workspaces with their status and the note kept on each one.

tools.name: set_note
tools.description: Write the note on a workspace. The person sees it in the workspace's Notes tab. An empty note clears it.

workspace_id.description: A workspace id from board_summary or list_workspaces.

note.description: The whole note; it replaces what was there.
